articles.summary: The full UNLESS brand is moving to UA.com, bringing its products and approach to material innovation to the front door of one of the largest sportswear businesses in the world.
articles.title: UNLESS Collective Moves to UA.com

articles.summary: Under Armour and SYZMIK Sports today announced a strategic licensing partnership that will redefine athlete protection in flag football and 7v7 football by bringing premium protective headwear to one of the world’s fastest-growing sports.
articles.title: Under Armour and Syzmik Sports Announce Global Partnership to Advance the Future of Flag Football & 7v7

articles.summary: Under Armour welcomes Cincinnati Bengals wide receiver Tee Higgins as the newest addition to its football roster. As an Under Armour athlete, Higgins will represent the brand on and off the field, showcasing Under Armour footwear, apparel and accessories. He will also be featured in marketing initiatives, including future extensions of Under Armour's WE LOVE FOOTBALL series.
articles.title: Under Armour Welcomes NFL Star Tee Higgins to its Football Roster
